title: Stop Doing This At Roundabouts (Part 1)
hook: Stop entering roundabouts in the wrong lane.

script.narration: Stop entering roundabouts in the wrong lane.
script.visual_search: car entering a multi-lane roundabout overhead view

script.narration: First, check your exit number before you even approach the circle.
Second, stay in the right lane if you are taking the first or second exit.
script.visual_search: car turning right into traffic circle

script.narration: Third, use the left lane only if you are going past the halfway point.
script.visual_search: car driving inside roundabout left lane

script.narration: Follow for daily driving tips so you don't miss Part 2!

description: Learn the proper lane choice for multi-lane roundabouts. Master these simple rules to avoid accidents and navigate traffic circles like a pro. Follow for daily driving tips and tricks.
why_it_will_work: Builds directly on proven high-performing channel formats focused on negative-framing hooks ('Stop doing this') combined with high-intent search queries for beginners.

series.name: Roundabout Mastery
series.next_part_idea: How to signal properly when exiting a multi-lane roundabout

quality_problems: fact-check: Roundabout lane rules vary significantly by country, region, and specific road signs, making absolute rules about left and right lanes misleading without local context.
